EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT)ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: ARA/LND/ACQVI/D3/30. Ministry of Irrigation Land, Livestock - Agriculture Ref.

No. : 4-3/15/2016/VE/400. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:-

Description of the land or servitude to be acquired : An allotment of land is called Debathgamawaththa (Kalugala) part about 10.7207 Hectares in extent which is depicted as Lot Numbers 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09 and 10 in the Cadastral Map Number 610395 and dated 08.08.2024 made by the Surveyor General and situated in the Village of Kalugala, in the No. 47D Kalugala Grama Niladhari Division, in the Minor Division of Ganhatha Palatha, in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Aranayaka, in the District of Kegalle, in Sabaragamuwa Province. Boundaries are as follows:

All persons interested in the aforesaid Land/Lands on which a servitude are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at the
Divisional Secretariat, Aranayaka on the 19th day of March, 2025 at 10.00 a.m.

They are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 12th day of March 2025, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation the details of the computation of such amount.
Shamali Piyathissa, Divisional Secretary, Aranayaka. Divisional Secretariat, Aranayaka, 23rd January, 2025. EOG 01 - 0272
